Introduction to Numismatics with Replicas

A 2.5-hour workshop, online or at your venue

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this workshop you identify coins as contextual evidence rather than priceable collectibles.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Replica handling and terminology
  • Symbols and inscriptions exercise
  • Context and dating caveats
  • Create a descriptive catalogue card

How the time is spent

  1. Replica handling and terminology 20 min

  2. Symbols and inscriptions exercise 45 min

  3. Context and dating caveats 55 min

  4. Create a descriptive catalogue card 30 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
